info.title: Relay Everything API
info.description: Read one person's Relay Everything notes, health, places, calendar and saved chats, and add notes. It changes and deletes nothing. Each caller reaches only the space of the person who connected it or made its key.

get.summary: Search notes, or read a time range
get.description: With `q`, the notes whose text holds every word, as the `search` tool: `source` picks older recorded or typed notes, and `limit` is at most 50. Without `q`, every note from `from` to `to`, as the `timeline` tool: both are needed, and `limit` is at most 100. Newest first; read on with `cursor`.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: The words to find.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: The first time: a day (2026-11-04), a time in the zone (2026-11-04T09:00), or a time with its offset.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: The time to stop before: a day (2026-11-04), a time in the zone (2026-11-04T09:00), or a time with its offset.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: Only older recorded notes, or only typed ones.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many notes, at most 100.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The last answer's `nextCursor`, to read the next page.

parameters.name: timezone
parameters.description: An IANA time zone, such as Europe/London, for days and the times in the answer; America/Toronto when left out.

title.description: The first 80 characters of the text.

recordedAt.description: A time in the asked zone, with its offset: 2026-11-04T09:01:00-05:00.

device.description: The name of the device that sent it.

post.description: Add a typed note, with this key's or app's name as its device, and send it on to the person's webhooks. Send the same `clientId` again after a lost answer: the note is stored once, and `added` is false. 201 when added.

clientId.description: Your own id for this note, 8 to 64 letters, digits or dashes, such as a new UUID, so a resend is stored once.

createdAt.description: When it was written; now when left out: a day (2026-11-04), a time in the zone (2026-11-04T09:00), or a time with its offset.

lat.description: Where it was written: latitude. Send it with lon.

lon.description: Where it was written: longitude. Send it with lat.

accuracy.description: How sure you are of the place, in meters.

place.description: The place's name, such as a street.

timezone.description: An IANA time zone, such as Europe/London, for days and the times in the answer; America/Toronto when left out.

added.description: False when this clientId was added before.
False when this clientId was added before.

get.description: One value per hour or day for one kind of health data: steps, sleep, mindful minutes and water (ml) as `total`; heart rate and blood pressure (mmHg) as min, max and average; workouts as a count and minutes; weight (kg) as `latest`; resting heart rate, heart rate variability (ms; hrv_sdnn from iPhone, hrv_rmssd from Android) as `average`; blood oxygen (%) as min and average; cycle flow as the highest `flow`, 0 none to 3 heavy. Sleep counts on the day it ends.

get.description: The location points of one stay or trip, by its `id` from places or day_summary, from the phone that made it; or every phone's points from `from` to `to`, at most 7 days. Each point has its time, lat, lon, accuracy (m) and street. Oldest first, at most 500, spread evenly with the first and the last; `total` says how many there were. No points means the person keeps only stays and trips, or the phone sent none: do not ask again.

oauth2.description: Connect an app with the person's own sign-in: register the app at `/register` (OAuth dynamic client registration), then the authorization code flow with PKCE (S256). Leave out `resource`, or send this server's `/mcp` address: the same token works on `/mcp` and here. An app connected before adding notes reads only; connect it again to add.

apiKey.description: An API key, made on the person's Relay Everything page with *Add a device*: send it as `Authorization: Bearer rek_…`. A phone's or a chat key is refused here.

error_description.description: What went wrong, in words to show a person.
